text_simplified: Children are an amanah (trust) with parents. Allah has praised the believing servants for preserving and caring for their trusts, warned against betraying or neglecting the amanah, and clarified that children and wealth are a trial and a test. Allah has prepared a great reward for those who fulfill the right of this amanah.
